description:
Write Bevy games in C#. Mark a struct [Behavior], give it [OnUpdate] methods, and a
            source generator registers it with the Bevy schedule as both a component and a system.
            Bevy is the engine underneath, providing its ECS, scheduler, renderer and input
            through a native bridge.
releaseNotes:
Blockout, a level of three rooms, a corridor and stairs between two floors blocked out from one recipe, is walked through the character controller and reshaped from the modeling window on Tab, and the booleans take a solid primitive's line as the cut does.
Dear ImGui's pass moves from the editor profile to the render one, so a game built on the package draws the interface it asks for with Config.Gui, the lock unchanged and the editor profile left with the asset watcher and the documentation of Bevy's reflected types.
The app leak test takes the heap's base as the greater of its twentieth and thirtieth readings, since macOS's heap read 103.34 MB at the thirtieth app and 90.84 at the fortieth and climbed back to 102.94 by the hundredth while its census found 0.3 MB more alive, the parameter and method infos it named made once by the census's own session, between the twentieth app and the sixtieth here and not after.
The recovery tests read the error count each frame and run on thirty frames past it within 600, since the device reported the error 14 to 45 frames after it was caused on an idle machine and 24 to 47 with all 32 cores loaded by stress-ng, past the frame 39 the stopped drawing test read it at.
The selected faces take texture coordinates of their own by planar, box, cylindrical and spherical projection, moved, scaled, turned and set to a texel density, and material slots take a color, a texture and the engine's maps, each a line of the recipe, a command and a row of the modeling window.
The modeling window shapes an edit mesh by its operations' buttons and by clicks and drags on its faces in the 3D view, and the editor's Model tab opens it on the model of the entity selected.
F2 saves a picture of the frame being drawn into a screenshots folder beside the program, named by the time as Minecraft names its own, with Capture.ScreenshotKey moving the key or turning it off.
The console gains a model command for every line of the recipe and new, free, list, info, recipe, undo, redo, save, load and show, each answering the model's counts, so a level is blocked out from the terminal.
The edit mesh gains union, subtract and intersect by csg.js's binary space partition with its pieces joined back into faces, cuts of primitives, windows and doors through a selected wall, rooms and ramps, and a room cut so in the feature test's gallery.
The grid image of a meter's cell is made with its mipmaps averaged as light through a new bridge export for an image given its levels, and the prototype materials tint it by the seven parts of a level, the ABI at 299.
The edit mesh gains extrude, inset, delete, merge, flip, triangulate, duplicate, join and shading, a recipe of its operations that is its undo and its file, a build into a mesh a slot with tangents and a collider, and a row of its primitives in the feature test's gallery.
The script test runs the client the suite's own build made, under a bound, where ./bcs built one inside the test and an MSBuild node it started held the output open, and the launchers build with no node kept for reuse.
The bcs record step waits on record.status for a recording's file, and build/animate.py makes captures on disk into a GIF, an animated PNG or an animated WebP by Pillow or by the engine's own writers through bcs animate, with Swarm's third wave as the README's first animation.
A run is recorded as an animated GIF or PNG by the record command and Capture.StartRecording, with a median cut palette, ordered dithering and LZW of the engine's own and an animated PNG over its own PNG writer.
An edit mesh of faces of any count is shaped from seven primitives through a selection that is moved, turned, scaled and snapped to a grid, with its guide page and the recipe's words for both engines.
title: BevyCSharp
